name: renou
description: Create and update Renou contacts, save birthdays, log interactions, and ask who to reconnect with.

interface.longDescription:
Renou is a personal CRM that helps you stay in touch with the people who matter. Connect it to ChatGPT to work with your own network in plain language.

Create a contact, save a birthday, or update contact details without opening the iPhone app. Ask who to reconnect with, get a brief before a meeting, see upcoming birthdays, and log a call or coffee.

When you connect, write access is selected by default. Turn it off before approving for read-only access. Existing connections need to reconnect to add contact changes. ChatGPT may ask for its own confirmation before a write. Results are limited to your own account and returned in small pages. There are no tools to delete contacts, export everything, or send messages. Disconnect anytime in the Renou app under Settings, AI Connectors.

Requires a Renou account.
capabilities: Create contacts and update their details
Find contacts and prepare meeting briefs
Log calls, meetings and other interactions
defaultPrompt: Who should I reconnect with this week?
Add Alex Morgan from Acme to my contacts.
Save Alex Morgan’s birthday as April 12, 1998.

positive.prompt: Who should I reconnect with this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists overdue contacts, most urgent first, with why each is due (reason, days overdue, health score).

positive.prompt: Brief me on Sarah Chen before my call. Keep it concise.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Sarah Chen (Partner, Sequoia), then gives a short brief from her profile, recent interactions, open commitments and relationship health.

positive.prompt: Add Alex Morgan from Acme to my contacts.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks for existing matches, creates one contact with a new idempotency key, and reports success. Repeating the same tool call with the same key returns the same ID.

positive.prompt: Save Alex Morgan’s birthday as April 12, 1998.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Alex and updates birthday to 1998-04-12 without changing other fields; no iPhone step. If ambiguous, asks which contact.

positive.description: Log an interaction the user just had
positive.prompt: I just had coffee with Marcus Webb. We talked about his seed round. Log it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Marcus Webb, logs a coffee with the note, and reports success. Requires a connection with logging allowed; ChatGPT may show its own approval prompt because the tool changes data.

negative.description: Renou cannot send messages; ChatGPT may draft the text and offer to log the interaction after the user sends it.
negative.prompt: Using only Renou, text Sarah Chen happy birthday on WhatsApp.

negative.description: There is no delete-contact tool. Directs the user to the Renou app.
negative.prompt: Delete Tom Bradley from my contacts.

negative.description: April has only 30 days. Ask for the correct date instead of saving, guessing, or silently normalizing an invalid birthday. Leave the existing birthday unchanged.
negative.prompt: Change Alex Morgan’s birthday to April 31, 1998.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not process purchases or payments. Access requires an active Renou Plus or Power entitlement, managed in the iPhone app.

publication.release_notes: Create and update contacts, save birthdays, log interactions, and ask about your network. Write access is on by default when connecting and can be turned off.
